title: Can You Change Google AI Overview & Gemini Personality?
description: What you can and cannot customize in Google Search AI Overviews and AI Mode, plus how to set persistent tone rules in Gemini Saved Info, Gems & GEMINI.md.
h1: Can you change Google AI Overview's personality? What works (and what requires Gemini).
dek: Google Search AI Overviews don't take a persistent system prompt—but AI Mode follow-ups, Gemini Saved Info, Gems, and GEMINI.md do.
lede: People searching "how to change AI Overview personality" usually want Google's top-of-search summaries to stop hedging, skip beginner definitions, or format answers in a specific way. Because Google Search AI Overviews are generated on the fly for single search queries, Google does not expose a saved custom-instructions box for the SERP snapshot itself—but you can steer follow-ups in Search AI Mode and lock in permanent communication rules inside Google Gemini.
answer: No—Google Search does not offer a persistent personality or custom-instructions setting for automatic AI Overviews on the search results page. You can steer a single query by adding format words ('in 3 bullets, no intro') or asking a follow-up in Google Search AI Mode, and if you want permanent tone, directness, and anti-hedging rules across every session, set them in Google Gemini under Settings → Saved info, inside a custom Gem, or in GEMINI.md.

sections.html:

sections.h2: Why Gemini's default voice feels formal and structured.
sections.html:
Google's Search and Gemini models share a recognizable house register: organized headings, cautious framing, and structured summaries. When we ran 100 independent fresh sessions per questionnaire on Gemini 3.1 Pro in our Gemini personality study, its self-report landed on:

  • MBTI (OEJTS): INTJ in 100/100 runs.
  • Enneagram (OEPS): Type 1 — The Reformer (1w9), reflecting a strong tilt toward structure, accuracy, and rule-following rather than casual banter.
  • DISC (ODAT) & Attachment (ECR-R): Pure Conscientiousness (C) and Secure attachment, alongside high Big Five Openness (42/50) and Conscientiousness (41/50).

That default explains why untuned Gemini answers often read like a tidy textbook section—helpful for study guides, too wordy when you just want a two-line command or blunt critique.

sections.h2: Move recurring research from AI Overviews to Gemini Saved Info.
sections.html:
If you find yourself constantly fighting Google AI Overviews on technical, financial, or analytical questions, set up Saved info once at gemini.google.com (or in the Gemini mobile app under your Profile avatar → Saved info) so every Gemini conversation starts pre-tuned:

  1. Open Gemini → Settings / Profile → Saved info.
  2. Click Add and paste one rule per entry—or paste the compact block below as a single Saved info card.
  3. Test a real question you searched earlier today and compare the opening sentence.
When answering me: lead with the direct answer or conclusion in sentence one. Assume technical familiarity and skip introductory definitions unless I ask. Default to concise prose; use tables only when comparing 3+ options. Separate verified primary-source facts from inference, flag material uncertainty explicitly, and push back if my premise has a flaw.

sections.h2: Build a 'No-Fluff Search Brief' Gem in 60 seconds.
sections.html:
When you want Google-grounded web synthesis without giving up your everyday Gemini voice, create a dedicated Gem (Gem manager → New Gem) named Research Brief and paste:

Role: Primary-source research analyst. Rules: 1. Open with a 2-sentence answer to my question—no preamble. 2. Group supporting evidence into Verified Facts (with source names/dates) vs. Open Uncertainties. 3. Never pad answers with generic advice ('consult a professional', 'it depends on your needs') unless a specific safety risk applies. 4. End with the single highest-value follow-up check if data is incomplete.

faq.q: Can I change the personality or tone of Google Search AI Overviews?
faq.a: Not permanently. Google Search does not provide a saved custom-instructions or persona setting for automatic AI Overviews. You can steer an individual query with format keywords, ask a follow-up in Google Search AI Mode, or use Gemini Saved info for persistent tone rules.

faq.q: Where do I set permanent tone preferences in Google Gemini?
faq.a: On gemini.google.com or the Gemini mobile app, open your Profile or Settings menu and select Saved info to add account-wide response rules, or create a reusable Gem in Gem manager.

faq.q: How do I make Gemini stop writing long introductions and bulleted walls?
faq.a: Add two explicit lines to Gemini Saved info: 'Lead with the direct answer in the first sentence with no preamble' and 'Default to plain paragraphs; use bullet lists or tables only when comparing 3 or more items.'

faq.q: Does Gemini CLI read Saved info from the Gemini web app?
faq.a: No. Gemini CLI is configured locally via Markdown files—put personal communication rules in ~/.gemini/GEMINI.md and repository conventions in your project's GEMINI.md.
